title: fix(python): correct SIWX nonce-storage record_nonce capability check
quote: the nonce-tracking capability check did getattr(storage, "has_record_nonce", None) — no such method exists. The documented storage contract and the TS twin check record_nonce. Fix: look up "record_nonce" (one line, mirrors the TS implementation).

title: [Bug]: Python SIWX hook looks up has_record_nonce (nonexistent method), so the nonce anti-replay check silently breaks
quote: A storage implementing exactly the documented pair fails at hook creation with a ValueError. A storage that implements only record_nonce passes the (broken) guard, but because record_nonce itself is gated on the same flag, it is never called.

title: fix(go): preserve abort-hook message in V2 facilitator errors
quote: the V2 Verify abort path builds NewVerifyError(result.Reason, "", ""), dropping the hook's Message. The V1 branch carries it through... Fix: pass result.Message through in both V2 branches.

title: [Bug]: Go facilitator drops the abort-hook Message from V2 verify/settle errors
quote: the Reason reaches the resource server but the Message, whatever free-text diagnostic the hook author set, gets built into an empty string on both the Verify and Settle V2 code paths.

title: fix(go): use configured RPC for batch-settlement gas sponsoring
quote: The Go EVM batch-settlement client resolved read and transaction-signing capabilities with an empty RPC URL, so EIP-2612 and ERC-20 approval gas sponsoring only worked with an RPC-backed signer... Add RPCURL and RPCByChainID to BatchSettlementEvmSchemeOptions.

title: fix(go): remove unimplemented ProcessPaymentRequest stub
quote: x402ResourceServer.ProcessPaymentRequest has been an exported stub that always returns not implemented, and nothing in the repo calls it. As agreed in #4089, this removes it outright instead of deprecating it.

title: style(go): drop restated comments from recent SDK fixes
quote: Cleanup-only pass on the Go SDK lines landed on main since 2026-10-31 in #4088, #4082, #4067, and #4096... Net lines removed: 5 (0 additions, 5 deletions).

title: fix(python): reject failed SVM confirmations
quote: Return transaction_failed for confirmed or finalized Solana execution errors, preserving the transaction signature and clearing V2 pending and duplicate entries. Closes #4032.

title: Python SVM signer reports failed confirmed transactions as settled
quote: Python SVM signer reports failed confirmed transactions as settled

title: feat(proxy): opt-in replay of paid deliveries after a client disconnect
quote: When a long upstream request outlives the client (or an edge timeout such as Cloudflare's 524), the upstream request is aborted and the payment is lost: a retry with the same credential gets 402, and a new credential pays again. This adds an opt-in replay option... After payment succeeds, the delivery is recorded under a key derived from the credential and the request's method, target and body (SHA-256), so a credential can only collect the request it paid for.

title: Proxy: paid requests cant be recovered when the client disconnects before a long upstream request finishes
quote: The charge settled, and the client received an HTTP 524 (origin timeout) after about 2 minutes with no result... Retrying with the same credential returns 402, because charge replay protection rejects it. Retrying with a new credential runs the request again and charges again.
